population: User-supplied XAUUSD M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 history 2023-01-03 through 2026-06-19. All post-M9M periods are research-exposed; this is robustness/design work, not independent validation.

cost_contract.extra_bps_tests: stress deductions only, not broker commission estimates

S1_M5_STRICT_MULTI_TIMEFRAME_LONG.stress_grid: 729 combinations: own W 160/200/240; M5 volume q45/q50/q55; M5 MACD q70/q75/q80; HTF W80/100/120; M15 MACD q70/q75/q80; H1 MACD+RCI q45/q50/q55
S1_M5_STRICT_MULTI_TIMEFRAME_LONG.interpretation: The M5 branch has useful frequency and aggregate edge but the edge is thin relative to transaction-cost stress. Do not promote the canonical single definition from exposed history.

S3_H1_HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_MOMENTUM_LONG.stress_grid: 81 combinations: H4 W80/100/120 x MACD q70/q75/q80 x D1 W80/100/120 x MACD q45/q50/q55

S4_H4_DAILY_TREND_LONG.stress_grid: 9 combinations: D1 W80/100/120 x RCI9 q45/q50/q55, D1 bullish EMA stack fixed

quarter_stability.interpretation: Weak periods are mostly asynchronous, which supports diversification across timeframes rather than forcing one branch to trade every regime.

monthly_net_return_correlation.interpretation: Historical monthly branch returns are only weakly correlated; portfolio breadth can add diversification as well as frequency.

dedup_frequency.method_for_frequency_only: Sort all S1/S2/S3/S4 candidate timestamps. Start a fixed window at the first event and cluster events inside the window; cluster composition is descriptive and must not be used as an entry filter because later events are future relative to the first event.

causal_one_position_portfolio_reference.definition: GOLD LONG only. Sort S1/S2/S3/S4 events chronologically. When flat, the first qualifying event opens one virtual position using that branch's own first-turn entry and own frozen proxy exit. While the position is active, later LONG events do not open another position; they are confirmation metadata only. Simultaneous timestamps use deterministic priority H4 > H1 > M15 > M5. No future event is used to decide the initial entry.

confidence_sequence_findings.warning: Simple agreement count is not a valid universal confidence rule. The order of timeframe signals materially changes outcomes.

research_decision: Keep M15 N3 as the primary deterministic branch.
Advance H1 S3 to deterministic repository reproduction because its nearby parameter neighborhood is unusually robust.
Keep M5 S1 auxiliary until cost/definition robustness improves; do not use its raw frequency to justify weak trades.
Keep H4 S4 premium/reference only until more fresh observations exist.
Use one-position GOLD dedup as the first portfolio accounting reference; do not pyramid overlapping LONG signals.
Treat later timeframe signals during an active trade as phase/confidence metadata, not additional positions.
Do not use a generic agreement-count confidence boost; sequence matters.
Keep M9R M15 Q1/Q2/Q3 risk-reward design frozen and separate until deterministic portfolio implementation is ready.
BTC remains a separate forward research family; do not transplant GOLD branch rules.
